standard_prerequisites.name: Representable sheaf h_U and extension by zero j_! of constant sheaves
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the sheaf represented by an etale scheme and the functor j_! applied to constant sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the sheaves whose constructibility is asserted.

standard_prerequisites.name: Constructibility by a partition into constructible locally closed strata
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the characterisation of constructibility through a partition and the result that an etale morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes is finite etale over the strata of a suitable partition
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the partition with respect to which the sheaves are shown constructible.

core_obligations: Choose the partition (proof lines 12198-12205): by the companion stratification result for the etale morphism j, the author takes a partition of X into constructible locally closed subschemes over which j becomes finite etale.
Constructibility of the representable sheaf (proof lines 12205-12208): over such a stratum the sheaf h_U is finite locally constant, hence constructible, which gives the first assertion.

Constant coefficients (proof lines 12208-12213): over the same strata the sheaves j_! of the constant sheaves attached to a finite abelian group or a finite module over a Noetherian ring are finite locally constant, which gives the remaining two assertions.
proof_roadmap: Use the stratification making j finite etale over each stratum.
Show that the representable sheaf and the extensions by zero of finite constant sheaves become finite locally constant over the strata.
Conclude constructibility in the three settings.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for an etale morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes the representable sheaf h_U and the extensions by zero of finite constant sheaves are constructible, in the three settings of sheaves of sets, abelian sheaves and modules over a Noetherian ring (statement lines 12184-12196). The proof uses the companion stratification result making the morphism finite etale over the strata of a suitable partition (proof lines 12198-12205) and then observes that all the sheaves in question become finite locally constant over those strata (proof lines 12205-12213). The non-formal content is the use of the stratification. The claim is H2: one partition plus three short verifications.
